title: 第15章 试探第16章 巨大差距
content_zh:
既然躲不过去，那就没必要再说太多。
于是萧玄策说道“那就依李家主所说。”
看到萧玄策已经答应下来，李乘风露出奸计得逞的笑容。
说道“既然我们小辈在切磋表现，我们是不是也下点彩头呀。”
看到萧玄策不回应，李乘风继续道“你们呢随意派出同龄人出来与我这三个弟子打三场。
我们采用三场两胜。
怎么样？”
萧玄策沉思片刻，回答道“可以。”
看着萧玄策如此淡定模样，李乘风心中暗暗骂道“继续装，等一会有你哭的。
呸！”
其实萧玄策之所以不担忧，不慌乱，是因为他知道自己儿子的实力完全可以碾压李乘风带来的三人。
所以萧玄策是真淡定，而不是李乘风想象的那样，是强行装出来的。
李乘风继续说道“我们的彩头就定五百中品灵石怎么样？”
听到这话萧玄策的嘴角抽搐了一下，想道“还有赶着送资源的，这五百中品灵石可是将近一个月的纯收入呢，啧啧啧，真狠！”
表面上不动声色，随后假意得说道“李家主，这不好吧，这可是你我家族一个月的纯收呢”
听到萧玄策如此说。
李乘风更加坚定自己的想法。
立马开口道“唔～，不过这彩头也是给胜利者的奖励嘛，所以多一些就当后辈的鼓励了嘛！”
萧玄策心中嬉笑不已“老东西，等一下看你怎么哭！”
“李家主说得有道理。”

萧玄策微微笑道。
萧玄策能不笑吗？这是有人上赶着给自己儿子送资源来了。
随后萧玄策对着一众弟子道“你们也听到李家主的话了吧，至于切磋赢得的彩头，也是归胜利者所有。”
听到这话，众人也是羡慕不已，但绝大部分的弟子都是不敢想的。
没看到那看台上的三个人是什么修为么，上去只有被虐的份。
到时还让家族丢脸，估计到手的奖励都没了。
就算是连萧强之流也是不太敢上，毕竟差距还是比较明显的。
看到一众弟子的反应，萧玄策也是知道他们所想，刚刚说的话只是为了到时得中品灵石能顺利给到萧天手中，而做一个提前铺垫了。
李乘风见到萧玄策没有下文，随即对身后的一个青年说道“清华，你上去讨教一下，萧家才俊的高招吧。”
说完，那个名叫李清华的年轻弟子一跃跳上擂台。
李清华是李家三个弟子当中年纪最小，也就刚刚过十五岁，但是修炼天赋强大，年纪小小就已经是锻体境八层天后期巅峰修为。
看到这一幕，萧家年轻弟子都看向了萧天的和萧天。
这两人是目前他们知道最强的。
当然萧天的具体实力有多强，他们不知道，但肯定比萧强要强大得多。
但是要面对的是比萧强修为还要高的李清华，大家心里也没有底。
而且这也是关乎整个家族脸面的大事，也是马虎不得。
最后也是萧玄策开口道“萧强，你上去跟李清华贤侄过几招，不过切记点到为止。”
“弟子明白”
听到这话，萧强点点回答道。
然后也一跃而起，跳上擂台。

这李家明显是为了找茬来的，那为什么萧玄策还如此说呢？这是众人心中疑惑的。
content_en:
Since it can't be avoided, there's no need to say too much.
So Xiao Xuance said, "Then follow what the Li family leader said."
Seeing that Xiao Xuance had agreed, Li Chengfeng smiled as if his plot had succeeded.
He said, "Since we juniors are comparing our performance, why don't we also win some prizes?"
Seeing that Xiao Xuance did not respond, Li Chengfeng continued, "You can send your peers out to play three games with my three disciples at will.
We use best of three games.
How is it? "
Xiao Xuance thought for a moment and replied, "Okay."
Seeing Xiao Xuance looking so calm, Li Chengfeng cursed in his heart, "Keep pretending, you will cry later.
Bah! "
In fact, the reason why Xiao Xuance was not worried or panicked was because he knew that his son's strength could completely crush the three people brought by Li Chengfeng.
So Xiao Xuance was really calm, not just pretending to be as Li Chengfeng imagined.
Li Chengfeng continued, "How about our winnings be set at five hundred middle-grade spiritual stones?"
Hearing this, the corner of Xiao Xuance's mouth twitched and thought, "There are still people who are rushing to send resources. These five hundred middle-grade spiritual stones are nearly a month's net income. Tsk, tsk, tsk, how cruel!"
On the surface, he remained calm, but then he pretended to say, "Master Li, this is not good, this is your and my family's net harvest for a month."
Hearing Xiao Xuance say this.
Li Chengfeng became more determined in his thoughts.
He immediately said, "Well~, but this jackpot is also a reward for the winner, so if you have more, you can use it as encouragement for the juniors!"
Xiao Xuance was laughing in his heart: "Old man, wait and see how you cry!"
"Master Li is right."
Xiao Xuance smiled slightly.
Can Xiao Xuance not laugh? This is someone who is rushing to send resources to his son.
Then Xiao Xuance said to the disciples, "You must have heard what Master Li said. As for the prizes won from the competition, they belong to the winner."
After hearing this, everyone was envious, but most of the disciples did not dare to think about it.
Didn't you see the cultivation level of the three people in the stands? They only wanted to be tortured.
By then, the family will be embarrassed, and all the rewards will probably be lost.
Even Xiao Qiang and his like don't dare to go up, after all, the gap is still quite obvious.
Seeing the reactions of the disciples, Xiao Xuance also knew what they were thinking. What he just said was just to pave the way for the middle-grade spiritual stone to be successfully given to Xiao Tian.
When Li Chengfeng saw that Xiao Xuance had nothing to say, he immediately said to a young man behind him, "Tsinghua University, go up and ask for advice on the clever tricks of the Xiao family's talents."
After saying that, the young disciple named Li Qinghua jumped onto the ring.
Li Qinghua is the youngest among the three disciples of the Li family, just over fifteen years old, but he has a strong talent for cultivation, and at a young age he is already at the peak of the late eighth-level cultivation of the Body Forging Realm.
Seeing this scene, the young disciples of the Xiao family all looked at Xiao Tian and Xiao Tian.
These two are currently the strongest they know.
Of course, they don't know how strong Xiao Tian is, but they are definitely much stronger than Xiao Qiang.
But they were facing Li Qinghua, who had a higher level of cultivation than Xiao Qiang, and everyone was unsure.
Moreover, this is also a major matter related to the face of the entire family, and it is not something to be careless about.
Finally, it was Xiao Xuance who said, "Xiao Qiang, go up and have a few moves with Li Qinghua's wise nephew, but remember to stop."
"Disciple understands"
After hearing this, Xiao Qiang nodded and replied.
Then he also jumped up and jumped onto the ring.
The Li family obviously came here to find trouble, so why did Xiao Xuance say that? This is what everyone is wondering about.
